steps.text: Several months later...
4:28 P.M. \ Cloudy
Military buffer zone between Kazdel's east/west battlegrounds
A small ambush.
Looks like you were right. A lot of people do seem to be after my head. What a pain.
Not too many of them. They must be trying to cut off the head of the snake in a hit-and-run.
We only have half a squad left. What a perfect time to try and take me out.
...Too bad for them it's a little too perfect. Just as planned.
All right, I'll catch up with you later. The Messenger for Kazdel should be back in a minute.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...What are you looking for?

steps.name: W
steps.text: That corpse... that's the assassin?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I knew he'd have it on him.

steps.name: W
steps.text: A note...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Actually, wait, did you know this guy?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We've worked together before. Went through hell together. Just a few months ago, we were at the Scar Market, toasting to a job well done.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He even said he wanted his daughter to marry me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's dumb. You're mercenaries. Sooner or later...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hold on, you didn't really—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Of course not. I turned him down.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...For other reasons, of course.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So, what does it say?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Useful stuff. Some intel from the Market. Gossip. Things worth looking into.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...And what about this?

steps.name: W
steps.text: They're all names... No, all pseudonyms or code names. And there's... candy drawn on the back of this? What's all this supposed to mean?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The more pieces of candy, the higher the payout. It's a system only a piece of shit like him could come up with. Whoever gets the most candies is the most dangerous mercenary.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Creeps like that really leave a bad taste in your mouth.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...But then again, this adds up to a fat stack. Who's footing the bill?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Every time we complete a contract, someone will usually put up an additional sum to get rid of us. Like whoever hired us, for example.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The more powerful the mercenary, the bigger the bounty. The bigger the bounty, the greater the risk. The greater the risk, the more they need to kill off the merc. And the mercs who live through all this... they become the strongest.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: This war has driven us to the brink of death, but it's also left room for us to survive.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I guess that all works.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's the rules of the game.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ... 'Hoederer, Mercenary, 10 candies. Tough squad, 15 candies. We're acquainted, 20 candies.'

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Can't fault his accounting.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: 'W, the old one, taken care of. The new one is a problem. 10 candies, maybe more, situational.'

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sounds like you earned your candies too.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Might have something to do with those arms dealers I buried alive in the woods last month.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah... So, am I supposed to be happy about this?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Arms dealers, huh... Why am I learning about this just now?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I was just in the neighborhood.

steps.name: W
steps.text: When you guys raid the Laterano caravans, do you bother reporting each and every one?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Right? It's the same idea.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Since this isn't technically a part of the job, it's not like us mercenaries have to share every little detail.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmm... But lemme get this straight. I'm stronger than that old 'W,' huh?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Strong or weak doesn't tell me shit about a soldier's actual capabilities. For me, it's all about whether or not they can follow orders.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Fine, fine. I'll be more thorough next time. Does that work for you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: By the way, I've been wondering, what kind of person was that old 'W?'

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That guy... was a strange one.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He was with us for a long time. Hardest worker you ever met, a real good egg.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He fought hard to become our team leader, racked up kills and commendations, just so we'd celebrate his birthday.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...A Sarkaz? With a birthday?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Of course it wasn't his real birthday... He wasn't that far gone.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He once killed a Laterano and took his gun. I guess they had some history between them, so he decided that day was his birthday.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Mhm... A merc who killed Lateranos for sport, huh? Sounds like we could've been friends.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: There's a lot to unpack in there.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But, 'for sport?'

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, gotta live in the moment.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Good answer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: 'W' was one of our biggest characters.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He always had that devil-may-care laugh, but whenever he spoke, you could tell that there was something more lurking underneath.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But he was quicker to trust than pretty much anyone else.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Because he had an 'obsession.' Obsessed people, good or bad, are always falling into traps.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...All right. Just sounds like a dumbass to me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I figured you'd get it..

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Because you're the same type of person. Good at putting on airs, good at living in the moment.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I am?

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Hah.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What makes you so confident you can guess what I'm thinking? Or, do you have some weird Arts like Ines?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You could've decided to kill us both that day. I thought you understood that?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: *Sigh*... You're not going to let that go, are you? Reminds me of Ines...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Let's head back and see how our Messenger's doing.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's about to rain.
That's the first time I saw her smile. The same smile as W's.
Giving her a thinly-veiled excuse was at least better than having her continue this numbingly dull busywork.
What I needed was a mercenary who could cleave a path forward, not just another puppet. Puppets are a dime a dozen..
That was the day W became W.
...But Ines was right.
Ridiculous.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ines, you should head back to the tent. No use staring blankly at a campfire.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph. Can't imagine we got good news from Kazdel.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Nail on the head.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I could feel the Messenger's anxiety after he came back. He tried not to show it, but he was scared out of his mind.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Not to mention your expression. Your poker face couldn't fool a toddler.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: So, what's the bad news?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So, I'm still alive, but... our agent died in Kazdel's industrial area.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: His corpse got thrown into a furnace. His head got melted off, but those gaudy red pants are somehow still fine.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Who did it?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Nobody knows when it happened. First person to find the body was one of the boiler workers.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But, whoever did it was quick. You have a fight on metal and it's gonna show for a while—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: They used a knife. And they were damned good with it.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Whatever. It's not like we'll ever catch them.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He wanted to hang out in Kazdel and didn't like to take orders. And this is what happens. Kinda funny, huh?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But now who's gonna pay us? I'm not laughing.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: And the next part is even less funny.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: When our Messenger was leaving Kazdel after confirming the report, he ran into some friends...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Some... spies.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I guess it's more 'was intercepted by' than 'ran into.'

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...So, we've been caught again?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Wouldn't be the first time. We could take the initiative here...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: By the look of things, we don't have a choice. The Messenger came back with an order.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...An order? For us? From who?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Since when do we take orders from anyone?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've gone through the options. Just let me finish.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: They want us off the battlefield and up to a remote mountain pass. Looks like it might take us through a canyon.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...To protect a transport team.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Escorting transports is a pretty run-of-the-mill job. There has to be more to it, right?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Excuse me?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Really sorry. The situation's spiraled out of control—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But this could be a rare opportunity for us.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Now that we're responsible for the entire team, the situation has changed. Everyone else is looking for an opening, and we can't just sit around waiting to die.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You and W are in charge of this job.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...I have some issues here.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: First of all, I won't go with W.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She's made some waves, but I don't think she's ready yet.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She's totally proven herself.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I see things you can't. I trust my Arts.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hoederer's team shows up with a new demolitions expert, and suddenly the battlefield is one big fiery explosion.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The other mercs are all playing it cool. The 'battlefield' changes every day, and you never know when it might swallow up your base camp.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She doesn't hesitate; not when she's lying, not when she's killing. She is too 'qualified' a mercenary. I can't tell how deep she is.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'm not looking for a knife in my back, and I don't think she's cut out for this 'escort' job. No matter how great you think she is, now's not the time to send out your greenhorn.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Or did you have some ulterior motives?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm working with the tools I've got.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Look at where we are. We can't leave people on the sidelines anymore.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Mercs don't have a dog in the fight, really. But that also means we don't belong anywhere. When the dust settles, we'll fade away, along with the war.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The difference is, war will return one day. But we have only one chance to live.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm not going to be fatalistic about this... and neither should any of you. That's the deal.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We have to play the hand we've been given. Stand out from the crowd, and stake out our own position.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...That group's here from Rim Billiton. I'm willing to bet they get raided not long after crossing into Kazdel territory.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: A lot of our people won't take the job. We'll have to change the teams up a bit, but it doesn't matter in the end.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's a dangerous contract, but worth the risk. We, or at least you—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hold up.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Not that I question your decision... It's just that...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Ah, forget it. Anyway, you don't need to be so uptight. I'll follow your orders, as always.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But first, you need to calm down, then take a look at your own feet.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Oh... Are you talking about my shadow?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I can't read your eyes. What am I looking for?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Your shadow. It's trembling.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...It's windy. And the campfire is flickering.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You know what I'm talking about. All you Sarkaz are like this.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't always try to plan too far ahead. There are too many things you can't control. We're just mercenaries, after all.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I'll keep that in mind.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: So, if you want me to bring W with me, what about you?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What are you planning?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That's on a need to know basis. You're safer this way.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If you can't trust the other teams, you should at least trust your own.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm not hiding anything from you, it's just...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Out with it then.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Spill it!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Who was it our Messenger met?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...'Babel.'

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: A sleeper cell Babel left in Kazdel.
